study: Exploratory replacement of two all-failure benchmarks after round 1
primary_method: M5: SD -> ELS NCG -> L-BFGSM, threshold switching

F7.reference: Round 1 F3 Block Bohachevsky 2: M5 300/300 and tied for highest absolute success count.
F7.change: Each 2D block changes 0.3[1-cos(3 pi u)cos(4 pi v)] to 0.3[1-cos(3 pi u + 4 pi v)]; quadratic part and F3 initialization box are retained.

F9.reference: Round 1 F8 had the largest success count gain of M5 versus overall leader M6: 118 vs 59 per 300. M4 reached 119.
F9.change: Each block of 8 uses F8's open Rosenbrock chain (coefficients 100 and 1) plus 2[1-cos(2 pi(x-1))] on each coordinate. No Rosenbrock coupling crosses a block boundary.

frozen_solver_and_measurement: Original solver, shared line search and timing implementation; original six methods, ten dimensions, thirty seeds, same stopping tolerances and budgets. New functions' function IDs are 7 and 9 for seed generation.
interpretation: Report round 2 beside the full round 1. Similarity of F3/F7 and F8/F9 is deliberate; combined rates describe this selected suite. Separate actual observations from the selection rationale. Do not treat reused rows or the exploratory comparison as a new independent replication.
